# Sepsis candidate screening form

Use one form per candidate document. Do not add a candidate to the verified master catalogue until all mandatory criteria are supported by the primary document and an independent second reviewer has completed the checks.

## Identification

- Candidate ID:
- Exact title:
- Conventional edition label:
- Earliest official publication date:
- Journal / issuing body:
- DOI:
- PMID / PMCID:
- Official primary-source URL:
- Direct full-text URL:

## Eligibility screening

| Criterion | Yes / No / Unclear | Evidence / page / URL |
|---|---|---|
| Published on/after 2000-01-01 | | |
| Formal guideline, consensus definition, or eligible position statement | | |
| Adult population (18+) or adult recommendations separable | | |
| Direct relevance to adult critical care | | |
| Recognised issuing body / formal international panel | | |
| Exact title, authors/group and date checked against primary source | | |
| Complete full text readable without payment or login | | |
| DOI / PMID / PMCID resolves to this same document | | |
| Edition status and later updates checked with issuing body | | |

## Access and licence

- Full text access method: official HTML / official PDF / OA journal / repository / other
- Logged-out full-text access tested on:
- Licence text exactly as displayed:
- Licence URL:
- Is redistribution expressly permitted? yes / no / unclear
- Notes: Public readability is not proof of redistribution permission.

## Edition and related-publication handling

- Canonical edition / family:
- Parallel publication DOI(s):
- Correction / erratum:
- Supersedes:
- Superseded by:
- Evidence for each relationship:
- Status: current / superseded / withdrawn / archived_historical / status_unknown
- Date status checked:

## Review outcome

- Reviewer 1:
- Reviewer 1 date:
- Reviewer 1 decision: include / exclude / needs correction
- Reviewer 2 (independent):
- Reviewer 2 date:
- Reviewer 2 decision: include / exclude / needs correction
- Discrepancy resolution:
- Final decision and rationale:

**Important:** Never infer GRADE, Delphi, adult-only scope, licence, currency, or supersession from a title, abstract, later publication, or search snippet. Record unknowns as unknown.
